root_cause: The canonical daily blog exporter treated content_ready as publication-ready even though the generated article included internal publication, SEO and reviewer instructions. A protected blog PR rendered those instructions directly to readers; the generation evidence also reported final_copy_approved=false.
intervention: Close unsafe blog candidate PR #4483 before merge. Add source-level reader-ready checks in the canonical static publisher before filesystem writes, and a regression test. Never silently delete editorial content or spoof approval.
prevention: Dated blog releases fail closed with BLOG_ARTIFACT_NOT_READER_READY when draft/publication-only instructions appear. Source remediation and valid public evidence are required before protected merge and public content-ID readback.
